subject: A sleep EEG 'brain age' score tracked future dementia risk
script: From Agewell Brief: A sleep EEG 'brain age' score tracked future dementia risk. A machine-learning model estimated “brain age” from overnight sleep recordings. Across five long-running cohorts, each additional 10 years between estimated brain age and chronological age was associated with a 39% higher risk of dementia. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
